title: Take the deposit
descriptionHold: The amount is held on the customer's card and released or charged after the return.
descriptionSaveCard: This rental is longer than a week, so the customer's card is saved instead of held. It can be charged after the return.
cardHoldHint: Hand the device to the customer to enter their card. Nothing is charged now.
cardSaveHint: Hand the device to the customer to save their card. Nothing is charged now.
